metadata.title: Machine Learning for Defect Diagnostics and Quality Assurance in Laser Powder Bed Fusion Ti-6Al-4V
metadata.governance_rules: Strict adherence to Global Rules A1-A16 and Gate Fix-Ups F1-F8

gates.hypothesis: Archives, metadata, and physical scale are verifiable and error-free
gates.evidence: 11/11 archives verified (0 corrupt); 773 specimens linked; absolute scale 0.55812 um/px verified; Ed energy identity confirmed analytically across all rows.

gates.hypothesis: Multi-scale panoramic tiling preserves void fraction without resin border contamination
gates.evidence: 50,494 tiles extracted across 734 specimens; 200 um absolute margin isolates mount resin; Nyquist criteria satisfied (keyhole 5th pctile = 13.5 net px >= 3).

gates.hypothesis: Automated QC isolates mosaic seams and explains all missing specimen exclusions
gates.evidence: 0.0% error rate on 50 extreme tiles; 39 crumbling LOF specimens (Ed ~10 J/mm3, density ~50.9%) safely isolated from training cohort to prevent resin seepage.

gates.hypothesis: Disjoint specimen grouping prevents leakage; optical porosity correlates with Archimedes density
gates.evidence: GroupKFold strictly disjoint (0 specimen overlap); optical vs Archimedes Pearson r = 0.8573; baseline Otsu specimen R2 = 0.9733, MAE = 0.6314%; leakage penalty dR2 = +0.0349.

gates.hypothesis: Deep vision backbones predict optical porosity from unsegmented grayscale tiles
Deep CNN outperforms a fair, like-for-like 256px Otsu baseline at the specimen level
gates.evidence: Paired dMAE (baseline - CNN) = -0.0054% [95% CI: -0.0415%, +0.0280%]. CI strictly includes zero, demonstrating statistical equivalence on clean brightfield micrographs.

gates.hypothesis: Microstructural visual features invert process parameters (Ed, P, v, h, t, dH/hs)
Hatch spacing h creates spatial periodicity in LOF voids beyond scalar pore metrics
gates.evidence: CNN beats 8-feature Extra Trees (dMAE = +2.84 J/mm3 [+2.13, +3.51]); hatch pitch detected in 19.75% of LOF specimens (p < 0.0001 vs 12.03% null). Section confirmed as horizontal xy.

gates.hypothesis: CNN preserves calibration under synthetic perturbations better than thresholding
gates.evidence: CNN wins 10 of 12 synthetic perturbations; Fair Otsu wins 1 (contrast_0.5); 1 tie (clean, CI includes 0); 1 both fail (noise_20, both R2 < 0.5).

gates.hypothesis: CNN classifies pore root causes (validated on crops only) better than tabular shape classifiers
gates.evidence: Validated on crops only (1,200 curated defect crops). CNN matches tabular shape classifiers (97.75% vs 97.25%, McNemar test p = 0.3616, n.s.). Random split leaks +0.42% accuracy.

gates.hypothesis: Pretraining on 316L stainless steel transfers zero-shot and beats ImageNet initialization
gates.evidence: Primary zero-shot: Unclipped R2 = -19.6691 (MAE = 24.3622%); secondary clipped R2 = -6.4366 (MAE = 23.4069%). Controlled adaptation matches ImageNet (R2 ~0.85 vs 0.87). Transfer NOT claimed.

gates.hypothesis: Grad-CAM saliency heatmaps are faithful to CNN decision logic under progressive pixel deletion
gates.evidence: Grad-CAM is pore-grounded (3.36x enrichment), but targeted deletion fails to drop prediction faster than random (dAUC = -4.4573 [-5.9857, -2.9267]). Integrated Gradients rejected (axiom violation ratio 8.13 > 0.05).

gates.hypothesis: Conformal prediction delivers >= 90% valid coverage and parts quality screening
gates.evidence: Split conformal coverage = 91.96% (within 88-92% window of 90%; mean width 1.3930%); screening accuracy at 0.5% limit is 96.78% (94.08% specificity, 99.48% sensitivity on rejects). Defect classification validated on crops only. Gumbel fits stratified by Ed tertile.

gates.hypothesis: All reported metrics are traceable to JSON/CSV data; figures at 300 DPI; 100% regex match
gates.evidence: All 16 consistency checks verified to 4-decimal exact match; 100% of 552 decimal numbers in reports and tables verified against source artifacts (tol < 1e-4).
